residual_definitions.classification_residual_priority: Residual B where high; otherwise Residual A where high.

matching_policy.method: same exact normalized team plus unique normalized published-roster-name prefix compatibility

physical_classification_policy.conflict_rule: Use Stage 1 metric/direct-T90/temporal-construct conflict only; do not resolve the conflict numerically.
physical_classification_policy.temporal_rule: Known non-2026 comparison measurements are physical temporal uncertainty; unknown-only eras remain insufficient evidence under the V2 Stage 1 boundary.
physical_classification_policy.support_rule: Outer cohort quartiles are directional compatibility only, not a cross-metric conversion or independent causal validation.
physical_classification_policy.insufficiency_rule: Use INSUFFICIENT_PHYSICAL_EVIDENCE when frozen Stage 1 does not supply an outer-quartile direction or explicit conflict.

queue_inputs: frozen Stage 1 V2 physical-only queue source

limitations: Residuals are external QA diagnostics, not correction targets and not new ratings.
The physical labels do not infer a numeric NPB+ to PowerPro bridge.
A physical direction compatible with a game value is not a causal explanation for the game value.
